concerns.text: Task T001 assumes a publicly downloadable experimental TOF CSV/URL, but the specification and plan state that no open experimental TOF dataset is currently available. This makes the task impossible to implement until a valid data source is provided, violating FR‑001.

Task T007 (XGBoost hyper‑parameter search & model saving) requires a training set that includes the target variable `experimental_tof`. Since the target data are unavailable (FR‑001 unmet), this task cannot be executed.
Task T008 (Linear baseline training) also depends on the missing `experimental_tof` column; without it the script cannot train or produce predictions.

Task T009 (Model evaluation & statistical significance testing) needs predictions from both XGBoost and linear models on a test set containing `experimental_tof`. The absence of the target data makes this task unexecutable.
Task T010 (SHAP importance calculation) loads the best XGBoost model trained on real TOF values. Since the model cannot be trained without the TOF dataset, this task cannot run.
Task T011 (Reduced‑model verification) depends on SHAP rankings and a trained XGBoost model, both of which are impossible without the experimental TOF data.
Task T012 (Generate final report) aggregates metrics, SHAP rankings, and alignment statistics that are unavailable because the modeling steps (T007‑T011) cannot be performed.

Task T013 defines an integration test that asserts the existence of all final artifacts (e.g., `best_xgboost.json`, `metrics.json`, `shap_barplot.png`, `final_report.md`). Given the upstream impossibility of generating those artifacts, the integration test will always fail.

The task list does not include a dedicated step to create the required directory skeleton (`data/raw/`, `data/processed/`, `outputs/`). While the scripts assume these directories exist, their absence would cause runtime errors, violating Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene).
